error_connect: The connection failed. Check the details and try again.
welcome_desc: Hontrio builds your Google Shopping campaigns from your catalog and optimizes them every day, automatically.
store_desc: Hontrio syncs your products and orders to understand what sells. Access is read-only, so your store stays exactly as it is.
edinio_desc: You authorize access right from your Edinio account, with no keys to copy. The connection sets itself up.
woo_tut_1_desc: Your store’s address followed by /wp-admin, with an administrator account.
woo_tut_2_title: WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API keys
woo_tut_2_desc: In the side menu, open WooCommerce → Settings, then the Advanced tab and the REST API keys section.
woo_tut_3_desc: Click Create an API key, enter “Hontrio” as the description, choose Read under Permissions (read access is all Hontrio needs) and click Generate API key.
woo_tut_4_desc: Consumer key (ck_…) and Consumer secret (cs_…). The secret is no longer shown once you leave the page.
shopify_desc: You authorize access right from Shopify, with no keys to copy. Make sure you’re signed in to the store’s Shopify account.
google_desc: Campaigns run in your own Google Ads account and ads are paid directly to Google. Hontrio manages them on your behalf.
google_store_account: Campaigns for {{store}} will run in the {{account}} account.
google_choose_later_one: We found {{count}} Google Ads account. You can choose the store’s account in Settings → Integrations.
google_choose_later_other: We found {{count}} Google Ads accounts. You can choose the store’s account in Settings → Integrations.
done_desc: The Overview lists the steps left before your first campaign: Merchant Center and the purchase conversion.
intro_store_desc: We sync your products and orders without changing anything in your store.
intro_google_desc: Campaigns run in your account, and ads are paid directly to Google.
woo_form_desc: The key is read-only: Hontrio doesn’t change products, prices or orders.
store_syncing_desc: We’re syncing your products and orders. You can continue the setup while this runs in the background.
store_synced_desc: Your products and orders are synced. From now on, Hontrio keeps them up to date automatically.
visual_0_title: Google Shopping campaigns, built from your catalog.
visual_0_desc: Hontrio creates, monitors and optimizes them every day.
visual_1_title: Your catalog is the foundation of every campaign.
visual_1_desc: We sync your products and orders to see what sells. Your store stays unchanged.
visual_2_title: Campaigns run in your own Google Ads account.
visual_2_desc: Ads are paid directly to Google, and the budget only goes up with your approval.
visual_3_desc: We set up Merchant Center, the conversion and the budget together, right from the Overview.
